k_reset_q: All progress and records will be erased. This cannot be undone.
tagline: Eight battles to take back the vale.
chronicle_d: Replay any battle you have won to train the company
help_select: Select a unit, its destination and an action
help_next: Jump to the next unit that has not moved
help_terrain: Forests, hills and castles protect; archers on hills shoot further
help_counter: Units strike back when they can reach the attacker
help_touch: Touch: tap a unit, tap where it goes, tap again to confirm
tip_select: Press {0} on a blue unit to move it
tip_terrain: Forests and hills cost more to cross but protect whoever stands in them
tip_counter: Check the forecast on the right before you attack
tip_endturn: When everyone has moved the enemy acts; {0} ends the turn early
tip_heal: Corin the cleric heals a neighbour instead of attacking
tip_seize: Bring Ser Maren to the flag to seize it
tip_danger: {0} shows every tile the enemy can reach
goal_seize: Goal: bring Ser Maren to the flag
m1_1: Ser Maren: Raiders on the border again. We hold the line here.
m1_2: Brand: Stay in the trees, Lysa. Let them come to us.
m2_1: Corin: The mill folk need us. I will mend whoever falls behind.
m2_2: Ser Maren: Hold the bridges. They cannot cross the river anywhere else.
m3_1: Tobin: Rider Tobin, at your service. The ford is ours if we are quick.
m3_2: Ser Maren: I will plant our banner on that keep myself.
m4_1: Lysa: Torches in the trees! They have us surrounded.
m4_2: Ser Maren: Hold the old shrine until dawn. Help is on the way.
m5_1: Ilse: You will want a mage for that fort. Stone does not stop my fire.
m5_2: Brand: The captain hides in his keep. Draw him out, then strike.
m6_1: Tobin: Archers on both hills. Riders through the middle, fast!
m6_2: Lysa: Take the high ground and they lose their advantage.
m7_1: Ser Maren: Aldmoor. My father's hall. We take it back today.
m7_2: Corin: Then we follow you to the gate, my lady.
m8_1: Warlord: You are too late, little knight. Aldmoor kneels to me.
m8_2: Ser Maren: Then stand and face me. For Aldmoor!
defeat_hint: Ser Maren must survive. Use terrain and let the cleric heal.
end1: The usurper's banner falls from the walls of Aldmoor.
end2: Ser Maren raises her father's colours, and the vale is free again.
end3: Thank you for playing Banners of Aldmoor.
